protocol: Only complete passing family/preamble cohorts, including their incorrect examples. Generate local MLP1 response under donor MLP0 write separately in original and prefixed context; apply each to prefixed recipient. Apply new-context direction at original-context norm; replay new-context response for cross-run verification. Combine with P8 for the complete direction-by-norm factorial. No fitted parameters; original response is an oracle for the same training token pair, not a token-only learned model.
